answer: A fluorometric verification protocol curbs Sybil attacks among autonomous drones surveying an alpine meadow. Verifiers challenge each agent to measure localized spectral signatures of floral nectar and airborne juniper pollen, validating inputs against atmospheric diffusion models. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of deploying physical optical sensors and flight hardware per identity. However, sudden wind gusts disrupt particulate distribution, causing false rejections.
